name: Agonizing Blast
entriesHtml:
Choose one of your known Warlock cantrips that deals damage. You can add your spellcasting ability modifier to that spell's damage rolls.

Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can change which of your damaging Warlock cantrips benefits from this invocation.
description:
Choose one of your known Warlock cantrips that deals damage. You can add your spellcasting ability modifier to that spell's damage rolls.

Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can change which of your damaging Warlock cantrips benefits from this invocation.

name: Ambush
entriesHtml: When you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check or an initiative roll, you can expend one Superiority Die and add the die to the roll, provided you don't have the Incapacitated condition.
description: When you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check or an initiative roll, you can expend one Superiority Die and add the die to the roll, provided you don't have the Incapacitated condition.

name: Armor of Shadows
entriesHtml: You can cast Mage Armor on yourself without expending a spell slot.
description: You can cast Mage Armor on yourself without expending a spell slot.

name: Ascendant Step
entriesHtml: You can cast Levitate on yourself without expending a Spell Slot.
description: You can cast Levitate on yourself without expending a Spell Slot.

name: Bait and Switch
entriesHtml:
When you're within 5 feet of a creature on your turn, you can expend one Superiority Die and switch places with that creature, provided you spend at least 5 feet of movement and the creature is willing and doesn't have the Incapacitated condition. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

Roll the Superiority Die. Until the start of your next turn, you or the other creature (your choice) gains a bonus to AC equal to the number rolled.
description:
When you're within 5 feet of a creature on your turn, you can expend one Superiority Die and switch places with that creature, provided you spend at least 5 feet of movement and the creature is willing and doesn't have the Incapacitated condition. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

Roll the Superiority Die. Until the start of your next turn, you or the other creature (your choice) gains a bonus to AC equal to the number rolled.

name: Careful Spell
entriesHtml: When you cast a spell that forces other creatures to make a saving throw, you can protect some of those creatures from the spell's full force. To do so, you spend 1 Sorcery Point and choose a number of those creatures up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature). A chosen creature automatically succeeds on its saving throw against the spell, and it takes no damage if it would normally take half damage on a successful save.
description: When you cast a spell that forces other creatures to make a saving throw, you can protect some of those creatures from the spell's full force. To do so, you spend 1 Sorcery Point and choose a number of those creatures up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature). A chosen creature automatically succeeds on its saving throw against the spell, and it takes no damage if it would normally take half damage on a successful save.

name: Commander's Strike
entriesHtml: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks to direct one of your companions to strike. When you do so, choose a willing creature who can see or hear you and expend one Superiority Die. That creature can immediately use its Reaction to make one attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7, adding the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll on a hit.
description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks to direct one of your companions to strike. When you do so, choose a willing creature who can see or hear you and expend one Superiority Die. That creature can immediately use its Reaction to make one attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7, adding the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll on a hit.

name: Commanding Presence
entriesHtml: When you make a Charisma (Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion) check, you can expend one Superiority Die and add that die to the ability check.
description: When you make a Charisma (Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion) check, you can expend one Superiority Die and add that die to the ability check.

name: Devil's Sight
entriesHtml: You can see normally in Dim Light and Darkness—both magical and nonmagical— within 120 feet.
description: You can see normally in Dim Light and Darkness—both magical and nonmagical— within 120 feet.

name: Disarming Attack
entriesHtml: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to disarm the target. Add the Superiority Die roll to the attack's damage roll. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw, or it drops one object of your choice that it's holding, with the object landing in its space.
description: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to disarm the target. Add the Superiority Die roll to the attack's damage roll. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw, or it drops one object of your choice that it's holding, with the object landing in its space.

name: Distant Spell
entriesHtml:
When you cast a spell that has a range of at least 5 feet, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to double the spell's range.

When you cast a spell that has a range of Touch, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to make the range of the spell 30 feet.
description:
When you cast a spell that has a range of at least 5 feet, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to double the spell's range.

When you cast a spell that has a range of Touch, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to make the range of the spell 30 feet.

name: Distracting Strike
entriesHtml: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to distract the target. Add the Superiority Die roll to the attack's damage roll. The next attack roll against the target by an attacker other than you has Advantage if the attack is made before the start of your next turn.
description: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to distract the target. Add the Superiority Die roll to the attack's damage roll. The next attack roll against the target by an attacker other than you has Advantage if the attack is made before the start of your next turn.

name: Eldritch Mind
entriesHtml: You have Advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain Concentration on a spell.
description: You have Advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain Concentration on a spell.

name: Eldritch Smite
prerequisite: Level 5 Warlock, Pact of the Blade
entriesHtml: Once per turn when you hit a creature with your pact weapon, you can expend a Warlock spell slot to deal an extra 1d8 Force damage to the target, plus another 1d8 per level of the spell slot, and you can give the target the Prone condition if it is Huge or smaller.
description: Once per turn when you hit a creature with your pact weapon, you can expend a Warlock spell slot to deal an extra 1d8 Force damage to the target, plus another 1d8 per level of the spell slot, and you can give the target the Prone condition if it is Huge or smaller.

name: Eldritch Spear
entriesHtml:
Choose one of your known Warlock cantrips that deals damage and that has a range of at least 10 feet. When you cast that spell, its range increases by a number of feet equal to 30 times your Warlock level.

Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can change which of your damaging Warlock cantrips benefits from this invocation.
description:
Choose one of your known Warlock cantrips that deals damage and that has a range of at least 10 feet. When you cast that spell, its range increases by a number of feet equal to 30 times your Warlock level.

Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can change which of your damaging Warlock cantrips benefits from this invocation.

name: Empowered Spell
entriesHtml:
When you roll damage for a spell, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to reroll a number of the damage dice up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one), and you must use the new rolls.

You can use Empowered Spell even if you have already used a different Metamagic option during the casting of the spell.
description:
When you roll damage for a spell, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to reroll a number of the damage dice up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one), and you must use the new rolls.

You can use Empowered Spell even if you have already used a different Metamagic option during the casting of the spell.

name: Evasive Footwork
entriesHtml: When you move at least 5 feet on your turn, you can expend one Superiority Die, rolling the die and adding the number rolled to your AC until the end of the turn.
description: When you move at least 5 feet on your turn, you can expend one Superiority Die, rolling the die and adding the number rolled to your AC until the end of the turn.

name: Extended Spell
entriesHtml:
When you cast a spell that has a duration of 1 minute or longer, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to double its duration, to a maximum duration of 24 hours.

If the affected spell requires Concentration, you have Advantage on any saving throw you make to maintain that Concentration.
description:
When you cast a spell that has a duration of 1 minute or longer, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to double its duration, to a maximum duration of 24 hours.

If the affected spell requires Concentration, you have Advantage on any saving throw you make to maintain that Concentration.

name: Feinting Attack
entriesHtml: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die to feint, choosing one creature within 5 feet of yourself as your target. You have Advantage on your next attack roll against that target this turn. If that attack hits, add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll.
description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die to feint, choosing one creature within 5 feet of yourself as your target. You have Advantage on your next attack roll against that target this turn. If that attack hits, add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll.

name: Fiendish Vigor
entriesHtml: You can cast False Life on yourself without expending a spell slot. When you cast the spell with this feature, you don't roll the die for the Temporary Hit Points; you automatically get the highest number on the die.
description: You can cast False Life on yourself without expending a spell slot. When you cast the spell with this feature, you don't roll the die for the Temporary Hit Points; you automatically get the highest number on the die.

name: Gaze of Two Minds
entriesHtml:
You can use a Bonus Action to touch a willing creature and perceive through its senses until the end of your next turn. As long as the creature is on the same plane of existence as you, you can use a Bonus Action on subsequent turns to maintain this connection, extending the duration until the end of your next turn. The connection ends if you don't maintain it in this way.

While perceiving through the other creature's senses, you benefit from any special senses possessed by that creature, and you can cast spells as if you were in your space or the other creature's space if the two of you are within 60 feet of each other.
description:
You can use a Bonus Action to touch a willing creature and perceive through its senses until the end of your next turn. As long as the creature is on the same plane of existence as you, you can use a Bonus Action on subsequent turns to maintain this connection, extending the duration until the end of your next turn. The connection ends if you don't maintain it in this way.

While perceiving through the other creature's senses, you benefit from any special senses possessed by that creature, and you can cast spells as if you were in your space or the other creature's space if the two of you are within 60 feet of each other.

name: Gift of the Depths
entriesHtml:
You can breathe underwater, and you gain a Swim Speed|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7 equal to your Speed.

You can also cast Water Breathing once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7.
description:
You can breathe underwater, and you gain a Swim Speed|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7 equal to your Speed.

You can also cast Water Breathing once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7.

name: Gift of the Protectors
prerequisite: Level 9 Warlock, Pact of the Tome
entriesHtml:
A new page appears in your Book of Shadows when you conjure it. With your permission, a creature can use its action to write its name on that page, which can contain a number of names equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

When any creature whose name is on the page is reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, the creature magically drops to 1 Hit Point instead. Once this magic is triggered, no creature can benefit from it until you finish a Long Rest|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7.

As a Magic action, you can erase a name on the page by touching it.
description:
A new page appears in your Book of Shadows when you conjure it. With your permission, a creature can use its action to write its name on that page, which can contain a number of names equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

When any creature whose name is on the page is reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, the creature magically drops to 1 Hit Point instead. Once this magic is triggered, no creature can benefit from it until you finish a Long Rest|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7.

As a Magic action, you can erase a name on the page by touching it.

name: Goading Attack
entriesHtml: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to goad the target into attacking you. Add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you until the end of your next turn.
description: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to goad the target into attacking you. Add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you until the end of your next turn.

name: Heightened Spell
entriesHtml: When you cast a spell that forces a creature to make a saving throw to resist its effects, you can spend 2 Sorcery Points to give one target of the spell Disadvantage on its saving throws against the spell.
description: When you cast a spell that forces a creature to make a saving throw to resist its effects, you can spend 2 Sorcery Points to give one target of the spell Disadvantage on its saving throws against the spell.

name: Investment of the Chain Master
prerequisite: Level 5 Warlock, Pact of the Chain
entriesHtml:
When you cast Find Familiar, you infuse the summoned familiar with a measure of your eldritch power, granting the creature the following benefits:

  • Aerial or Aquatic.

    The familiar gains either a Fly Speed|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7 or a Swim Speed|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7 (your choice) of 40 feet.

  • Quick Attack.

    As a Bonus Action, you can command the familiar to take the Attack action.

  • Necrotic or Radiant Damage.

    Whenever the familiar deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, you can make it deal Necrotic or Radiant damage instead.

  • Your Save DC.

    If the familiar forces a creature to make a saving throw, it uses your spell save DC.

  • Resistance.

    When the familiar takes damage, you can use your Reaction to grant it Resistance against that damage.
description:
When you cast Find Familiar, you infuse the summoned familiar with a measure of your eldritch power, granting the creature the following benefits:

- **Aerial or Aquatic**

The familiar gains either a Fly Speed|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7 or a Swim Speed|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7 (your choice) of 40 feet.
- **Quick Attack**

As a Bonus Action, you can command the familiar to take the Attack action.
- **Necrotic or Radiant Damage**

Whenever the familiar deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, you can make it deal Necrotic or Radiant damage instead.
- **Your Save DC**

If the familiar forces a creature to make a saving throw, it uses your spell save DC.
- **Resistance**

When the familiar takes damage, you can use your Reaction to grant it Resistance against that damage.

name: Lessons of the First Ones
entriesHtml:
You have received knowledge from an elder entity of the multiverse, allowing you to gain one feat of your choice, such as Skilled, that lacks prerequisites.

Repeatable.

You can gain this invocation more than once. Each time you do so, you must select a different eligible feat.
description:
You have received knowledge from an elder entity of the multiverse, allowing you to gain one feat of your choice, such as Skilled, that lacks prerequisites.

**Repeatable**

You can gain this invocation more than once. Each time you do so, you must select a different eligible feat.

name: Lifedrinker
prerequisite: Level 9 Warlock, Pact of the Blade
entriesHtml: Whenever you hit a creature with your pact weapon, the creature takes 1d6 extra Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage (your choice), and you can expend one of your Hit Dice to roll it and regain a number of Hit Points equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1).
description: Whenever you hit a creature with your pact weapon, the creature takes 1d6 extra Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage (your choice), and you can expend one of your Hit Dice to roll it and regain a number of Hit Points equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1).

name: Lunging Attack
entriesHtml: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die and take the Dash action. If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line immediately before hitting with a melee attack as part of the Attack action on this turn, you can add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll.
description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die and take the Dash action. If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line immediately before hitting with a melee attack as part of the Attack action on this turn, you can add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll.

name: Maneuvering Attack
entriesHtml: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to maneuver one of your comrades into another position. Add the Superiority Die roll to the attack's damage roll, and choose a willing creature who can see or hear you. That creature can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed without provoking an Opportunity Attack from the target of your attack.
description: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to maneuver one of your comrades into another position. Add the Superiority Die roll to the attack's damage roll, and choose a willing creature who can see or hear you. That creature can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed without provoking an Opportunity Attack from the target of your attack.

name: Mask of Many Faces
entriesHtml: You can cast Disguise Self without expending a spell slot.
description: You can cast Disguise Self without expending a spell slot.

name: Master of Myriad Forms
entriesHtml: You can cast Alter Self without expending a spell slot.
description: You can cast Alter Self without expending a spell slot.

name: Menacing Attack
entriesHtml: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to frighten the target. Add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.
description: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to frighten the target. Add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.

name: Misty Visions
entriesHtml: You can cast Silent Image without expending a spell slot.
description: You can cast Silent Image without expending a spell slot.

name: One with Shadows
entriesHtml: While you're in an area of Dim Light or Darkness, you can cast Invisibility on yourself without expending a spell slot.
description: While you're in an area of Dim Light or Darkness, you can cast Invisibility on yourself without expending a spell slot.

name: Otherworldly Leap
entriesHtml: You can cast Jump on yourself without expending a spell slot.
description: You can cast Jump on yourself without expending a spell slot.

name: Pact of the Blade
entriesHtml:
As a Bonus Action, you can trace arcane sigils in the air to conjure a pact weapon in your hand—a Simple or Martial melee weapon of your choice with which you bond—or create a bond with a magic weapon you touch. Until the bond ends, you have proficiency with the weapon, you can use its Mastery property, and you can use it as a spellcasting focus.

Whenever you attack with the bonded weapon, you can use your Charisma modifier for the attack and damage rolls, instead of using Strength or Dexterity, and you can cause the weapon to deal Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage or its normal damage type.

Your bond with the weapon ends if you use this feature's Bonus Action again, if the weapon is more than 5 feet away from you for 1 minute or more, or if you die. A conjured weapon disappears when the bond ends.
description:
As a Bonus Action, you can trace arcane sigils in the air to conjure a pact weapon in your hand—a Simple or Martial melee weapon of your choice with which you bond—or create a bond with a magic weapon you touch. Until the bond ends, you have proficiency with the weapon, you can use its Mastery property, and you can use it as a spellcasting focus.

Whenever you attack with the bonded weapon, you can use your Charisma modifier for the attack and damage rolls, instead of using Strength or Dexterity, and you can cause the weapon to deal Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage or its normal damage type.

Your bond with the weapon ends if you use this feature's Bonus Action again, if the weapon is more than 5 feet away from you for 1 minute or more, or if you die. A conjured weapon disappears when the bond ends.

name: Pact of the Chain
entriesHtml:
You learn the Find Familiar spell and can cast it as an action without expending a spell slot.

When you cast the spell, you choose one of the normal forms for your familiar or one of the following special forms: imp, pseudodragon, quasit, skeleton, slaad tadpole, or sprite.

Additionally, when you take the Attack action, you can forgo one of your own attacks to allow your familiar to make one attack of its own with its Reaction.
description:
You learn the Find Familiar spell and can cast it as an action without expending a spell slot.

When you cast the spell, you choose one of the normal forms for your familiar or one of the following special forms: imp, pseudodragon, quasit, skeleton, slaad tadpole, or sprite.

Additionally, when you take the Attack action, you can forgo one of your own attacks to allow your familiar to make one attack of its own with its Reaction.

name: Pact of the Tome
entriesHtml:
Stitching together strands of shadow, you conjure forth a book in your hand at the end of a Short Rest|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7 or Long Rest|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7. This Book of Shadows (you determine its appearance) contains eldritch magic that only you can access, granting you the following benefits:

  • Cantrips and Rituals.

    When the book appears, choose three cantrips, and choose two level 1 spells that have the Ritual tag. The spells can be from any class's spell list, and they must be spells you don't already have prepared. While the book is on your person, you have the chosen spells prepared, and they function as Warlock spells for you.

  • Spell Slot.

    You gain a level 1 spell slot. Once you expend it, you can't gain another slot from this feature until you finish a Long Rest|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7.

  • Spellcasting Focus.

    You can use the book as a Spellcasting Focus.

The book disappears if you conjure another book with this feature or if you die.
description:
Stitching together strands of shadow, you conjure forth a book in your hand at the end of a Short Rest|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7 or Long Rest|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7. This Book of Shadows (you determine its appearance) contains eldritch magic that only you can access, granting you the following benefits:

- **Cantrips and Rituals**

When the book appears, choose three cantrips, and choose two level 1 spells that have the Ritual tag. The spells can be from any class's spell list, and they must be spells you don't already have prepared. While the book is on your person, you have the chosen spells prepared, and they function as Warlock spells for you.
- **Spell Slot**

You gain a level 1 spell slot. Once you expend it, you can't gain another slot from this feature until you finish a Long Rest|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7.
- **Spellcasting Focus**

You can use the book as a Spellcasting Focus.

The book disappears if you conjure another book with this feature or if you die.

name: Parry
entriesHtml: When another creature damages you with a melee attack, you can use your Reaction and expend one Superiority Die to reduce the damage by the number you roll on your Superiority Die plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice).
description: When another creature damages you with a melee attack, you can use your Reaction and expend one Superiority Die to reduce the damage by the number you roll on your Superiority Die plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice).

name: Precision Attack
entriesHtml: When you miss with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die, roll that die, and add it to the attack roll, potentially causing it to hit.
description: When you miss with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die, roll that die, and add it to the attack roll, potentially causing it to hit.

name: Pushing Attack
entriesHtml: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to drive the target back. Add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll. If the target is Large or smaller, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet directly away from you.
description: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to drive the target back. Add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage roll. If the target is Large or smaller, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet directly away from you.

name: Quickened Spell
entriesHtml: When you cast a spell that has a casting time of an action, you can spend 2 Sorcery Points to change the casting time to a Bonus Action for this casting. You can't modify a spell in this way if you've already cast a spell of level 1 or higher on the current turn, nor can you cast a spell of level 1 or higher on this turn after modifying a spell in this way.
description: When you cast a spell that has a casting time of an action, you can spend 2 Sorcery Points to change the casting time to a Bonus Action for this casting. You can't modify a spell in this way if you've already cast a spell of level 1 or higher on the current turn, nor can you cast a spell of level 1 or higher on this turn after modifying a spell in this way.

name: Rally
entriesHtml: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die to bolster the resolve of a companion. Choose an ally of yours who can see or hear you. That creature gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the Superiority Die roll plus your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (your choice).
description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Superiority Die to bolster the resolve of a companion. Choose an ally of yours who can see or hear you. That creature gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the Superiority Die roll plus your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (your choice).

name: Repelling Blast
entriesHtml: When you hit a Large or smaller creature with Eldritch Blast, you can push that creature up to 10 feet straight away from you.
description: When you hit a Large or smaller creature with Eldritch Blast, you can push that creature up to 10 feet straight away from you.

name: Riposte
entriesHtml: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you can use your Reaction and expend one Superiority Die to make a melee attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7 against the creature. If you hit, add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage.
description: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you can use your Reaction and expend one Superiority Die to make a melee attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7 against the creature. If you hit, add the Superiority Die to the attack's damage.

name: Seeking Spell
entriesHtml:
If you make an attack roll for a spell and miss, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to reroll the d20, and you must use the new roll.

You can use Seeking Spell even if you have already used a different Metamagic option during the casting of the spell.
description:
If you make an attack roll for a spell and miss, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to reroll the d20, and you must use the new roll.

You can use Seeking Spell even if you have already used a different Metamagic option during the casting of the spell.

name: Subtle Spell
entriesHtml: When you cast a spell, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to cast it without any Verbal, Somatic, or Material components, except Material components that are consumed by the spell or that have a cost specified in the spell.
description: When you cast a spell, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to cast it without any Verbal, Somatic, or Material components, except Material components that are consumed by the spell or that have a cost specified in the spell.

name: Sweeping Attack
entriesHtml: When you hit a creature with a melee attack using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to damage another creature. Choose another creature within 5 feet of the original target and within your reach. If the original attack roll would hit the second creature, it takes damage equal to the number you roll on your Superiority Die. The damage is of the same type dealt by the original attack.
description: When you hit a creature with a melee attack using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to damage another creature. Choose another creature within 5 feet of the original target and within your reach. If the original attack roll would hit the second creature, it takes damage equal to the number you roll on your Superiority Die. The damage is of the same type dealt by the original attack.

name: Tactical Assessment
entriesHtml: When you make an Intelligence (History or Investigation) check or a Wisdom (Insight) check, you can expend one Superiority Die and add that die to the ability check.
description: When you make an Intelligence (History or Investigation) check or a Wisdom (Insight) check, you can expend one Superiority Die and add that die to the ability check.

name: Thirsting Blade
prerequisite: Level 5 Warlock, Pact of the Blade
entriesHtml:
You gain the Extra Attack feature for your pact weapon only. With that feature, you can attack twice with the weapon, instead of once, when you take the Attack action on your turn.

When you reach level 11 in this class, this Extra Attack confers two extra attacks rather than one.
description:
You gain the Extra Attack feature for your pact weapon only. With that feature, you can attack twice with the weapon, instead of once, when you take the Attack action on your turn.

When you reach level 11 in this class, this Extra Attack confers two extra attacks rather than one.

name: Transmuted Spell
entriesHtml: When you cast a spell that deals a type of damage from the following list, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to change that damage type to one of the other listed types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, Thunder.
description: When you cast a spell that deals a type of damage from the following list, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to change that damage type to one of the other listed types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, Thunder.

name: Trip Attack
entriesHtml: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike|XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7, you can expend one Superiority Die and add the die to the attack's damage roll. If the target is Large or smaller, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the Prone condition.

name: Twinned Spell
entriesHtml: When you cast a spell, such as Charm Person or Hold Person, that can be cast with a higher-level spell slot to target an additional creature, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to increase the spell's effective level by 1.
